# Cascade List API

Display hierarchy levels side by side and select a leaf directly.

This page is lookup reference for the exact public contract. Start from the usage examples when you are composing or styling the component.

[Back to Cascade List usage and examples](/components/cascade-list)

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Up</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Down</kbd> | Move between eligible items in the current column. |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> | Move to the parent column or enter the highlighted branch. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> | Move to the first or last eligible item in the current column. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Open the highlighted branch or select the highlighted leaf. |
